title: Self-Service Additional Credit Flow
description: Redesign of the self-service flow so people behind on payments don't see additional credit offers, with real-time checks and clear messages about their status
reto: At kubo.financiero we found that some people behind on payments could see active additional credit offers in the self-service flow, because of a lag in how the system updated. It caused confusion and extra work for the support and collections teams. The challenge was to redesign the flow so only people eligible at that moment saw offers, and to explain why when there was no offer.

proceso.investigacion: I spotted the problem through advisor reports and support monitoring. I mapped the steps of the self-service additional credit process, focusing on how the status of the previous loan was validated.
proceso.diseno: I defined a validation point at the start of the flow to check whether the user was up to date on their loan. I designed a screen that clearly tells them their status has changed and that no offer is available for now. I iterated on the message to make it clearer and more empathetic, and proposed an illustration to reinforce it.
proceso.desarrollo: I worked with engineering to define the triggers and technical conditions needed to run the validation in real time.

aprendizajes: When a loan's status changes, a clear message prevents frustration. Business conditions have to be checked on entry to the flow and again when the offer is shown. And a screen with no action, like "no offer available", needs an empathetic message so people don't drop off.

hero.alt: Two paths going through a check: one reaches the offer and the other a message, next to a phone showing the loan screen.

items.texto: Loan status is checked before any offer is shown.
A clear message explains why the person doesn't see an offer.
Design, engineering, collections and support, aligned on one flow.

destacado.intro: The problem was a system lag, and people saw it as a real offer.

items.texto: People behind on payments could see active additional credit offers.
Only people eligible at that moment see offers.
A dead-end screen needs an empathetic message so people don't drop off.
